selected_work: VR_BACKEND_100_REVIEW_SET_04:F13 R126 bounded live adoption of the shared producer map for the single exact PutGhostGapInfo_sub GhostGap HUD callsite 0xBDAE8.
summary: R126 preserves the existing float left/right sprite-spacing correction at PutGhostGapInfo_sub 0xBDAE8 while replacing its spacing-only callback with an exact caller-RVA template. The template derives immediate next-draw ScreenHud ownership from GameSemantic::ClassifyCriticalProducer(CallerRva) and compile-time requires the canonical shared producer map. 0xBDAE8 is already classified consistently as GhostGap/SCREEN_HUD by disasm_render_contract.hpp, analyze_outrun_exe.py and hud_semantics.hpp. The four separate GhostGap ForceLeft/Right sites remain unchanged. No producer range was widened.

risk_review.reason: src/hooks_uiscaling.cpp and render_semantics.hpp are protected runtime-risk paths. This change does not widen SCREEN_HUD ownership, change D3D state heuristics, or activate native draw routing; it converts only one already-canonical GhostGap HUD callsite. Prior R51 runtime evidence still shows producer ownership can arrive too late for the c64/WVP boundary, so hosted CI cannot establish visual correctness.
